about: Evolution for the Godot version (docs/proposals/creature-catalogue-and-evolution.md section 2; DD-5). New forms and the ways creatures change, beyond the browser game's single level evolutions. Merged into the game data at start: species are added, and evos replace a species' old single evolution. Each evo: to, and at (the level; always required), and any of bond (an added trust step: 1 Friendly, 2 Loyal, 3 Devoted, 4 Bonded), place (a map), with (a species in your team), time, weather, ate, raised (care or battle) and raised_at (that record's trust step). Trust is added to the level. It does not replace it. The first matching option wins, so put special ones first and the ordinary one last. hint is what Maren thinks; the field book shows the first hint once you've seen the creature. bond_branch is the shape for CAT-2's future creature, not a creature you can meet yet. Wild lists Godot-only encounters as [species, weight] beside a map, kept off the shared map export.

pyremane.name: Pyremane
pyremane.dex: Its mane became a crown of fire on the mountain where the ground runs warm. It walks into storms as if they were rain.

deeptide.name: Deeptide
deeptide.dex: It only takes this form for a tamer it trusts completely. In deep water it moves like the tide itself, and it never leaves that tamer's side.

elderthorn.name: Elderthorn
elderthorn.dex: A small wood grows on its back, and the birds that raised it with you nest there still. Where it sleeps, seedlings come up in spring.

mistlynx.name: Mistlynx
mistlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up in the cloud of the high pass. It slips through fog without a sound and is gone before you see it move.

sunlynx.name: Sunlynx
sunlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up devoted to its tamer. Its coat holds the morning light, and it lies across the doorway at night to keep it in.

dawnchorus.name: Dawnchorus
dawnchorus.dex: A Mistfinch that greeted the dawn. Its song carries the first light.

duskwing.name: Duskwing
duskwing.dex: A Mistfinch that hunts at dusk. It flies without a sound.

rainback.name: Rainback
rainback.dex: A Brineskit raised in the rain. Water beads on its back and never falls.

gorgebelly.name: Gorgebelly
gorgebelly.dex: A Brineskit fed on fish. It grew broad and strong.

creekribbon.name: Creekribbon
creekribbon.dex: A ribbon of dark water in the creeks of Saltmarsh Coast. A pale ring circles its middle, and it practises holding the surface still.

murkcoil.name: Murkcoil
murkcoil.dex: The pale ring has gone dull, and the body has thickened. It coils in the pools of Hollowecho Hills, still learning how to part the water.

gloomtide.name: Gloomtide
gloomtide.dex: The dull ring opened into a crest of still water. It crosses a creek without a splash, and the dark follows only where it allows.

seedmoth.name: Seedmoth
seedmoth.dex: It shelters one seed under a wing and dries it over the warm ash of Emberfall Highlands. The wing is still too small to be a garden.

sootcloak.name: Sootcloak
sootcloak.dex: Ash has crusted the wings it meant to open. It drags them, heavy and lopsided, and it still keeps that one seed warm.

hearthbloom.name: Hearthbloom
hearthbloom.dex: The crust split. Its wings open like a small garden, and the seed it carried is the first flower.

dawnfoal.name: Dawnfoal
dawnfoal.dex: A pale foal of Stillreed Basin that stands in the shallows at first light. One spark sleeps in its mane, and it sets each hoof down as if afraid to lose it.

sunford.name: Sunford
sunford.dex: The spark became a mane of morning. Where it steps through a ford, the water lights, and people follow the bright hooves home.

whisperpup.name: Whisperpup
whisperpup.dex: A small hound of Hollowecho Hills. Its ears are too big for its head, and it turns them until the wind in the stones matches a path.

ridgehowl.name: Ridgehowl
ridgehowl.dex: Those oversized ears caught the ridge wind. Its howl runs ahead of a lost walker and lays the path back under their feet.

charcup.name: Charcup
charcup.dex: A little turtle of Saltmarsh Coast that cups one warm coal in a hollow of its shell. It keeps the coal alive.

kilnback.name: Kilnback
kilnback.dex: The coal became a kiln. Seams of heat glow between the plates of its shell, and cold hands are welcome on its back.

blazefang.hint: The heat of Emberfall may wake something in it, once it's strong enough.

tidewyrm.hint: It changes only for a tamer it trusts completely, once it has grown.

thornback.hint: Birds nest on the greatest Thornback. Raise it beside a Glimmerwing.

poolkit.hint: Poolkit grows to suit its home. Raised in the cloud, it turns quiet.
A Poolkit devoted to its tamer grows warm and bright.
Most Poolkit become river cats. Most, not all.

mistfinch.hint: A Mistfinch that sees the dawn becomes something that sings with it.
A Mistfinch that flies at dusk learns the quiet ways.
Most Mistfinch become cloud harriers. Most, not all.

brineskit.hint: A Brineskit caught in the rain grows to love it.
A Brineskit fed on fish grows broad and strong.
Most Brineskit become shoal crests. Most, not all.

creekribbon.hint: Once it has grown, the pale ring goes dull and the body thickens.

murkcoil.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the dull ring opens into a crest of still water.

seedmoth.hint: Once it has grown, warm ash crusts the wings it is trying to open.

sootcloak.hint: Once it trusts you deeply and has grown, the crust splits and the wings open like a garden.

dawnfoal.hint: Once it trusts you a little and has grown, the spark in its mane lights the ford.

whisperpup.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, those ears catch the ridge wind.

charcup.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the coal in its shell becomes a little kiln.

bond_branch.about: CAT-2 will name this creature and point these options at it. Not placed, and not a species yet. Every option asks for a level. care is trust from feeding, a festival or a letter; battle is trust from fights together. The same five steps as bond. Trust and how it was raised are added to that level. They do not replace it. First match wins, so the gentle final is listed before the keen one, and the ordinary level change is last. A save with no raised record takes the ordinary option.

options.hint: Cared for until it is Loyal, it grows gentle.
Raised in the fight until it is Loyal, it grows keen.
Left to grow up, it takes the ordinary form.
